explication: This Terraform module provisions an AWS Application Load Balancer and supporting infrastructure. A caller supplies configuration, Terraform creates the load balancer, listeners, target group, security groups, and optionally access-log storage, then exposes outputs. The README documents these capabilities and resources; source excerpts were not provided, so the graph uses only documented relationships.
